description: This file defines an interface 'IPingGrain' for an Orleans grain, which includes methods for running a task and ping-pong interleaving with another grain.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a task with no parameters, returning a ValueTask.

methods.name: PingPongInterleave
methods.description: Performs a ping-pong interleave operation with another 'IPingGrain' instance, with a specified count.
